title: AI for Software Design: Behavioral Programming
shortDescription: Run an unsafe behavioral controller, add one independent overflow-safety b-thread, and verify the capacity invariant.
learningOutcomes: Explain Request-Wait-Block synchronization in a behavioral program.
Add an independent safety requirement without rewriting existing functional behaviours.
Verify a software safety invariant using execution traces and automated tests.

tasks.title: Run the unsafe baseline
tasks.description: Execute the supplied hot/cold controller and observe the capacity violation.

tasks.title: Implement overflow prevention
tasks.description: Complete the independent safety b-thread and enable it.

tasks.title: Verify the invariant
tasks.description: Run the safe controller and pass the public behavioral tests.

tasks.title: Document the result
tasks.description: Capture the design, execution evidence, and software-engineering interpretation in the report.
